role_and_message.evidence: The F architecture still presents the source three-part content-driven angle estimation, rotation-rectified orthogonal attention and decoupled periodic refinement.

panel_and_object_coverage.evidence: The full original architecture, entire attention computation plus sampling-group illustration, and entire refinement diagram remain.

labels_math_and_numbers.evidence: All Q indices, x/y/w/h/theta components, angles theta and theta+pi/2, group identities, alpha_i and modulo[0,pi) match the source.

connections_and_direction.evidence: The original pixel-preserved architecture retains backbone/encoder/attention/refinement paths and query updates. Complete B and C panels preserve their internal data flow and angle dependency.

visual_encodings.evidence: The cyan/yellow sampling groups, black reference point, blue positional and black content channels and purple refinement encoding retain source meaning. The full B panel restores the intact yellow legend dot.

examples_and_data.evidence: Three complete original regions independently match deterministic proportional resizes, covering the input photo, all sampling points, equations and full internal topology.

unsupported_additions.evidence: New statements that orientation is excluded from the positional prior and that position/periodic angle are refined separately are supported by Sec3.2/3.3. Computation and Orthogonal sampling groups are descriptive headings.

remaining_limitations: Original source diagrams and illustrative distribution shapes are retained. Cosmetic frame/callout continuity and repeated subtitle issues are left to blind quality assessment.
